notes: The margin's literal gloss (And wouldest thou deceive with thy lips?) was read and set aside under rule 38; it corroborates that the second colon is a rhetorical question the ASV has recast as a prohibition.

The second not was given to the אַל of the first colon under rule 25's distributed negative. The materially different readings are to give it to the interrogative הֲ, whose rhetorical force the ASV has converted, or to mark it added.
The interrogative particle is unrepresented because the ASV writes no question auxiliary at all (rule 17).
